fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. The strike deals 9 damage and unravels the target's guard, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cast-Off Slough
fusions.desc: Throws your shed skin across the 3 tiles ahead of you. It deals 4 damage to everything it lands on and leaves each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Empty Skin
fusions.desc: You leave your shed skin behind and slip 2 tiles from where you stood. For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Wound Dressing
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
